{{Quote|The enemy is at our gates. My men have fought valiantly alongside the Jedi, but our losses are terrible. The Jedi claim they have a plan to turn the tide, but I don't know if I can trust them.|Major Fewn Hew|<ref name="SWG:MLD">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=item|Mustafar Lore Disk}}</ref>}}
'''Fewn Hew''' was a military [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who lived during the [[Old Sith Wars]].

==Biography==
During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]],<ref name="TEA" /> [[Major/Legends|Major]] Fewn Hew commanded a contingent of [[Soldier/Legends|troops]] on the planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]],<ref name="SWG:MLD" /> the site of a large [[Jedi enclave (Mustafar)/Legends|Jedi Enclave]].<ref name="SWG:FotG" /> In [[3996 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith]] [[Devastation of Mustafar/Legends|attacked]] the planet. Major Hew and his men fought valiantly alongside the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] but they suffered terrible casualties.<ref name="SWG:MLD" /> At some point, the Jedi decided to turn the tide of the battle by unleashing the power of a mysterious and colossal [[Force crystal]]. Although the plan worked perfectly at the beginning,<ref name="SWG:FotG" /> Hew was quite skeptical about this strategy.<ref name="SWG:MLD" /> Eventually, the crystal exploded and immediately put an end to the battle as it decimated every combatants present on Mustafar and ravaged the surface of the planet.<ref name="SWG:FotG" />

Millennia later,<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Epo Qetora]] discovered records of Major Fewn Hew at the battle of Mustafar during the exploration of an [[Old Research Facility]] on Mustafar.<ref name="SWG:Ahl" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fewn Hew was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MLD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The mention of Fewn Hew was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:MLD" />
